name: KyCalendar
description: Calendars, scheduling and CalDAV sync for teams, part of the Ky Suite.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The database, the encryption key and the session secret in .icestore/ (made on first start), and initial-admin-password until you delete it. Back up the whole folder.

paths.name: Backups
paths.description: Sealed backup capsules that KyCalendar makes every day.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: KyCalendar web app and CalDAV for calendar apps, published on host as 6876. Plain http, for your https reverse proxy to point at: sign-in only works through the proxy's https address. Calendar apps use that https address and an everyday account with an app password; the admin account is refused on CalDAV.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: KY_APP_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace https://calendar.example.com with the https address of your reverse proxy (like Nginx Proxy Manager) that points at http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:6876. KyCalendar needs https to sign in: its sign-in check only runs on an https page. It must be the exact address you open in the browser, or sign-in and changes are refused.

variables.name: KY_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The first password of the admin account. Leave it empty to have one made for you: it is shown in the app's logs (CREDENTIALS) and saved as initial-admin-password in the data folder. Change it after your first sign-in.
